title: Learn 80% of OpenCode Desktop in 20 Minutes! | Full Beginner Tutorial
description:
In this video, I'll show you everything you need to get started with OpenCode Desktop as a beginner. We'll compare it to Claude Code, go through the installation and setup process, create your first project, connect GitHub, configure model providers, and explore powerful features like slash commands, Skills, MCP servers, and the Build & Plan agents.

By the end of this tutorial, you'll have everything you need to start using OpenCode Desktop as your AI coding assistant.
